sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Chapter Eleven Sharing the road

FACT_ID: sec11-R01 | anchor: A02
Marked and unmarked crosswalks grant walkers equal priority with every approach yielding, and red-lit school buses plus stopped-for-walker vehicles freeze all passing. [A02]
Why it matters: group walkers; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec11-F04, sec11-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=68]

FACT_ID: sec11-R02 | anchor: A03
Riders hold lanes or right edges except when turning left or dodging hazards, pair at most two abreast, and helmet through age thirteen. [A03]
Why it matters: group cyclists; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec11-F07 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=69]

FACT_ID: sec11-R03 | anchor: A03
Night cycles show heads five hundred feet ahead, tails three hundred behind, and one lamp two hundred to each side, a three-rung visibility ladder. [A03]
Why it matters: group equipment; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F09 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=69]

FACT_ID: sec11-R04 | anchor: A05
Two motorcyclists may share one lane side-by-side yet no rider may share or pass within a lane holding any non-motorcycle vehicle. [A05]
Why it matters: group motorcycles; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec11-F13 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=71]

FACT_ID: sec11-R05 | anchor: A07
Class A mopeds reach thirty-one to forty with motorcycle licenses and any-lane rights, B twenty-one to thirty and C twenty-or-less with any-class licenses and right-lane limits. [A07]
Why it matters: group mopeds; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec11-F17 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=73]

FACT_ID: sec11-R06 | anchor: A08
Lower mopeds hug right edges, Class A roams freely, and every moped shuns expressways unless signs invite, all approached with cyclist-grade care. [A08]
Why it matters: group mopeds; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F18 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=74]

FACT_ID: sec11-R07 | anchor: A08
Long-hood tractors blind twenty feet ahead beyond deep rear and side shadows, so returns wait for full fronts in mirrors and cutoffs stay banned. [A08]
Why it matters: group trucks; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec11-F18, sec11-F19 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=74]

FACT_ID: sec11-R08 | anchor: A06
Left-turning vehicles meet forty-one percent of fatal riders, so car-seeking eyes must retrain into multi-hazard scans covering cycles among trucks buses bikes and walkers. [A06]
Why it matters: group attention; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec11-F15 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=72]
